recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future changes to MedicationRequest.performer, performerType, or device performer semantics should be handled through newer Pharmacy decisions rather than reopening FHIR-12439.
issue_request: FHIR-12439 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request for DSTU2 asking MedicationRequest to include an intended performer for medication treatment or administration, with separate representation for the desired actual performer and role/type.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies git-svn commit 4b21106775caa782aa07057cdc51cb67b83f467f as the TR#12439 implementation. That commit added MedicationRequest.performer to the historical MedicationRequest spreadsheet source as a 0..1 Reference to Practitioner, Organization, Patient, Device, or RelatedPerson.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, and later source conversion/refactoring carried the concept into structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml. Current source contains MedicationRequest.performerType and MedicationRequest.performer with evolved current cardinality/target profiles. FHIR-13449, a published companion issue, added intended-performer search support now present in source. FHIR-37631, already represented on the combined branch, later clarified device-versus-performer wording without undoing the FHIR-12439 requirement.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scope source already satisfies the seed request, and editing it for the older literal cardinality/type wording would be redundant and risk reversing later accepted refinements.

related_jiras.note: Published follow-up explicitly accompanying FHIR-12439 that added the intended-performer search parameter now present in current source.
Published later clarification of MedicationRequest device-used versus device-performer wording; already represented on the combined branch and consistent with the current evolved performer text.
